neighbours.label: the purpose noun in a 'For convenience / For simplicity / For clarity' aside that excuses a simplification
fire: For clarity, the error bars have been left out of the second plot.
In this chapter, for brevity, we write f for the full transfer function.
For convenience, all prices in the table are rounded to the nearest dollar.
We drop the subscript for simplicity, since only one sample is used.
For readability, the long lines of the listing have been wrapped.
For ease of reference, the rules are numbered in the margin.
Units are omitted for simplicity in the equations that follow.
For clarity of presentation, the minor roads are not shown on the map.
quiet: For instance, the error bars in the second plot are very wide.
In this chapter, for example, we write f for the full transfer function.
For the most part, all prices in the table are listed in dollars.
We drop the subscript in chapter two, since only one sample is used.
For years, the long lines of the listing were printed on one page.
For the first time, the rules are numbered in the margin.
Units are given in metres in the equations that follow.
For the second edition, the minor roads are shown on the map.
